name: ff0l icon library
rules: CS2 weapons, grenades, armor, kits → collection cs2 (SVG paths under icons/cs2/equipment/).
Custom overlay set (crosshair, eye, globe, weapon, sliders, gear) → dopamina / icons/custom/dopamina.ttf, codes A–F from icons/custom/defs.txt.
General UI icons → fa-7.3.0, style solid, class `fa-solid fa-<name>`. CSS in icons/fontawesome/v7.3.0/.
Brand logos → fa-7.3.0 style brands, class `fa-brands fa-<name>`.
Lighter line icons → remix (icons/remix/remixicon.ttf) when a Remix name is a better match.
Do not use FA 6/5 unless the consuming project is pinned to that version.
UI text → Montserrat or Inter. Titles → League Spartan, Oswald, or Syne. Dense small UI → Tahoma Bold or Verdana. Code → JetBrains Mono or Fira Code. Faces live in typefaces/.
C++ embeds live in embeds/*.hpp; extracted copies are embeds/extracted/.

collections.name: Font Awesome Pro 7.3
collections.useWhen: Default UI icons. Prefer solid for overlays and dense tools.

collections.name: Font Awesome Pro 6.7
collections.useWhen: Only when a project is pinned to FA 6.

collections.name: Font Awesome Pro 5.15
collections.useWhen: Only when a project is pinned to FA 5.

collections.name: Remix Icon
collections.useWhen: Line/fill UI icons when FA feels too heavy or a Remix name fits better.

collections.name: CustomIconPack DOPAMINA
collections.useWhen: Custom overlay pack. Known map: A crosshair, B eye, C globe, D weapon, E sliders, F gear.

collections.name: iconsV2
collections.useWhen: Second custom icon font. Inspect glyphs before using.

collections.name: tab_icon
collections.useWhen: Tiny custom font, likely a single tab glyph.

collections.name: FA Solid 900 (loose TTF)
collections.useWhen: Loose FA solid file. Prefer icons/fontawesome/v7.3.0.

collections.name: FA 7 Free Solid
collections.useWhen: Free solid subset. Prefer Pro 7.3 in this library.

collections.name: CS2 Equipment
collections.useWhen: Counter-Strike weapon, grenade, armor, and utility art. Always prefer these over generic gun icons.
